items.quote: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat
items.claim: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet at the basin location

items.quote: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses
items.claim: They washed when entering the tent of congregation and approaching the altar, in obedience to the LORD's command to Moses
